commit.message:
Avoid state corruption via bailout

- Replace bailout on OOM with UnwindExit
- Properly reset various globals that may be accessed during startup

Fix GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w (CVE-2026-109618)
Fix GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp (CVE-2026-109619)

+--TEST--
+Delayed OOM while a call frame is only partially built
+--DESCRIPTION--
+A delayed OOM throws from the VM interrupt handler, which runs between two
+oplines. Argument unpacking grows test()'s frame past a VM stack page, so it is
+ZEND_CALL_ALLOCATED and owns the page; the interrupt is then delivered after the
+explode() call, while that frame is still pending.
+--FILE--
+<?php
+
+function test(...$args) {}
+
+$args = array_fill(0, 20000, 1);
+$str = str_repeat('abcdefgh,', 300);
+
+test(...$args, ...[explode(',', $str)]);
+
+?>
+===DONE===
+--EXPECT--
+===DONE===

+--TEST--
+bzcompress() output buffer pre-allocation doesn't reach hard limit
+--EXTENSIONS--
+bz2
+--INI--
+memory_limit=512M
+--SKIPIF--
+<?php
+if (getenv("USE_ZEND_ALLOC") === "0") die("skip Zend MM disabled");
+?>
+--FILE--
+<?php
+$limit = 512 * 1024 * 1024;
+$hard = 2 * $limit;
+
+// Fill the heap to just under the memory limit.
+$subject = str_repeat("a", $limit - memory_get_usage(true) - 64 * 1024);
+
+// bzcompress() pre-allocates source + 1% + 600 bytes for its output, which
+// leaves it about 1% too big for the gap that is left before the hard limit.
+$dest_len = (int) (strlen($subject) + 0.01 * strlen($subject) + 600);
+var_dump($dest_len > $hard - memory_get_usage(true));
+
+bzcompress($subject);
+echo "not reached\n";
+?>
+--EXPECTF--
+bool(true)
